ideas: Preserve per-channel rank before fusion; use best rank per retriever type across query variants.

Deduplicate original source IDs and diversify by relevance versus passage redundancy.
Explicit plan/search/inspect/refine/finalize stages with bounded execution.
Scoped provider contract; an inaccessible or failed scope is not retried unconstrained.
